steps: Sign in at netflix.com on a web browser (cancellation is not available in the mobile app).
Go to Account, then select Cancel Membership under Membership & Billing.
Confirm the cancellation. Access continues until the end of the current billing period.
netflix.note: Steps may vary slightly by region or account type — verify directly before proceeding.

steps: Sign in at one.google.com with the account's credentials.
Select Cancel subscription and confirm. Files above the free storage limit may become read-only after cancellation — check before proceeding.
google one.note: Cancelling may affect access to stored files if usage exceeds the free tier — review storage contents first.

steps: Go to Plans, then select Manage plan next to the active subscription.
Select Cancel plan and follow the confirmation steps. An early-cancellation fee may apply depending on the plan terms.
adobe.note: Annual plans may involve a cancellation fee — verify the specific plan terms before proceeding.

steps: Go to your account page and select Manage your plan.
Choose Cancel subscription and follow the prompts.
spotify.note: Steps may vary by region, plan type, or may have changed, so verify directly before proceeding.
